mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, channel_type AS channelType, endpoint, enabled, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM em_notification_channel WHERE (#{projectId} IS NULL OR project_id = #{projectId}) ORDER BY enabled DESC, channel_code, id

SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, project_id AS projectId, workflow_code AS workflowCode, workflow_name AS workflowName, workflow_status AS workflowStatus, trigger_mode AS triggerMode, result_summary_json AS resultSummaryJson, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM em_event_response_workflow WHERE (#{projectId} IS NULL OR project_id = #{projectId}) ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, project_id AS projectId, workflow_code AS workflowCode, workflow_name AS workflowName, workflow_status AS workflowStatus, trigger_mode AS triggerMode, result_summary_json AS resultSummaryJson, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM em_event_response_workflow WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND workflow_code = 'EVENT_RESPONSE_V3' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, workflow_id AS workflowId, step_order AS stepOrder, step_code AS stepCode, step_name AS stepName, status, related_task_type AS relatedTaskType, related_task_id AS relatedTaskId, message, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM em_event_response_step WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} ORDER BY step_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, event_id AS eventId, template_id AS templateId, report_type AS reportType, report_title AS reportTitle, docx_url AS docxUrl, pdf_url AS pdfUrl, report_url AS reportUrl, report_hash AS reportHash, status, generated_by AS generatedBy, generated_at AS generatedAt, source_record_key AS sourceRecordKey, metadata_json AS metadataJson FROM em_report_instance WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY COALESCE(generated_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) DESC, id DESC

SELECT e.id, e.project_id AS projectId, l.event_id AS eventId, e.station_id AS stationId, e.resource_type AS resourceType, e.resource_url AS resourceUrl, e.captured_at AS capturedAt, e.source_record_key AS sourceRecordKey, e.hash_value AS hashValue, e.metadata_json AS metadataJson, l.link_type AS linkType, l.confidence, l.remark, e.created_at AS createdAt FROM em_event_evidence_link l JOIN em_evidence_resource e ON e.id = l.evidence_id WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, project_id AS projectId, action_type AS actionType, operator_name AS operatorName, message, attachments_json AS attachmentsJson, created_at AS createdAt FROM em_event_handling_log WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO em_event_response_workflow (event_id, project_id, workflow_code, workflow_name, workflow_status, trigger_mode, result_summary_json, started_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{projectId}, 'EVENT_RESPONSE_V3', 'SHM-EM event response v3', 'running', 'event_triggered', JSON_OBJECT('steps', 4, 'core', 'notification_report_evidence'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE workflow_status = VALUES(workflow_status), result_summary_json = VALUES(result_summary_json)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM em_event_response_workflow WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND workflow_code = 'EVENT_RESPONSE_V3' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO em_event_response_step (workflow_id, step_order, step_code, step_name, status, related_task_type, related_task_id, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepCode}, #{stepName}, #{status}, #{relatedTaskType}, #{relatedTaskId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), related_task_type = VALUES(related_task_type), related_task_id = VALUES(related_task_id), finished_at = VALUES(finished_at)

INSERT INTO em_report_instance (project_id, event_id, template_id, report_type, report_title, content_text, report_url, report_hash, status, generated_by, generated_at, source_record_key, metadata_json) SELECT #{projectId}, e.id, t.id, 'event', CONCAT('Event Report ', e.event_code), CONCAT('Event Code: ', e.event_code, CHAR(10), 'Source: ', e.source_type, CHAR(10), 'Run Type: ', e.run_type, CHAR(10), 'Risk Level: ', e.event_level, CHAR(10), 'Metric: ', e.metric_code, CHAR(10), 'Detected At: ', DATE_FORMAT(e.detected_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'), CHAR(10), 'Trigger / Threshold: ', COALESCE(e.trigger_value, ''), ' / ', COALESCE(e.threshold_value, ''), ' ', COALESCE(e.unit, ''), CHAR(10), 'Reason: ', COALESCE(e.trigger_reason, ''), CHAR(10), 'Calculation Snapshot: ', COALESCE(CAST(e.calculation_snapshot_json AS CHAR), '{}')), NULL, SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|', e.event_code, e.source_type, e.run_type, e.event_level, e.metric_code, DATE_FORMAT(e.detected_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'), e.trigger_value, e.threshold_value, e.unit, CAST(e.calculation_snapshot_json AS CHAR)), 256), 'generated', 'EVENT_RESPONSE_V3', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONCAT('event_report:', #{projectId}, ':', #{eventId}, ':', t.id), JSON_OBJECT('createdBy', 'EVENT_RESPONSE_V3', 'sourceType', e.source_type, 'runType', e.run_type, 'eventCode', e.event_code) FROM em_monitoring_event e JOIN em_report_template t ON (t.project_id = #{projectId} OR t.project_id IS NULL) AND t.report_type = 'event' AND t.enabled = 1 WHERE e.id = #{eventId} AND e.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.project_id DESC, t.id ASC LIMIT 1 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE report_title = VALUES(report_title), content_text = VALUES(content_text), report_hash = VALUES(report_hash), status = VALUES(status), generated_by = VALUES(generated_by), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at), metadata_json = VALUES(metadata_json)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM em_report_instance WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND report_type = 'event' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE em_event_response_workflow SET workflow_status = 'completed', result_summary_json = JSON_OBJECT('steps', 4, 'core', 'notification_report_evidence', 'notificationTaskId', #{notificationTaskId}, 'reportId', #{reportId}), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{workflowId}
